t: A palm-sized AI camera that runs Linux and small chat models offline.
steps: Buy the MaixCAM2 kit from the Sipeed store or a reseller.
Pick the 4 GB version for chat-style AI models.
Download the free MaixVision app on your computer.
Connect the kit to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open MaixVision and connect to the camera.
Run the YOLO object detection example and watch the labels appear on screen.
Change the memory setting on the 4 GB model to use all of its memory.
Browse MaixHub for ready-made apps and models.
